column1: # Per-replica verdicts for every run that carries a per-case claim in round 115. This is the

# the selected column equal expected, valid is how many entries it has, and rivals is the rest.
# Anyone can recount both files against each other without the archived reports.
# errors marks each replica in order: '.' produced a verdict, 'E' did not (excluded from valid).
